text: Bright 1-bed flat near Heuston, €650/month, bills included. Landlord abroad, will post keys after deposit. WhatsApp me.

signals.title: Linked to a confirmed scam ring
signals.evidence: Shares a phone number with a listing confirmed as a scam (2 hops from 8 linked reports).

signals.title: Price far below market
signals.evidence: €650/month for a 1-bed in Dublin 8; the average is €2,100 (69% lower).

signals.title: Matches a known scam script
signals.evidence: Asks for a deposit before viewing, as the "absent landlord" script does.

verdict.summary: Medium risk: the phone number is shared with a confirmed scam and the price is about 70% under market. Do not pay before viewing in person.
